name: [Aesthetic] Cassette Futurism
nl: Cassette-futurist rendering: the future imagined through 1970s hardware, beige and grey mouldings, amber CRT glow and rocker switches, chunky bezels under fluorescent office light, photograph style image.
negative: sleek glass minimalism, brushed aluminium modernity

name: [Aesthetic] Neumorphism
nl: Neumorphic rendering: forms extruded from one pale ground, soft dual shadows above and below every shape, near-invisible edges, monochrome surface with faint inner glow, graphic style image.
negative: hard drop shadows, saturated colour blocks

name: [Aesthetic] Swiss Punk
nl: Swiss-punk rendering: the grid broken on purpose, type stepped and letterspaced to breaking point, heavy rules and rotated blocks colliding, photocopy grain across flat spot colour, poster style image.
negative: orderly grid alignment, glossy corporate polish

name: [Aesthetic] New Wave Typography
nl: New-wave rendering: layered translucent planes of pastel colour, wide letterspacing and stepped baselines, dotted rules and floating fragments, early digital gradients over halftone, poster style image.
negative: rigid single-column layout, muted neutral palette

name: [Aesthetic] Googie
nl: Googie rendering: boomerang angles, starbursts and cantilevered roof planes, plate glass beside terrazzo and neon tubing, optimistic desert daylight with hard shadow, photograph style image.
negative: sober modernist restraint, overcast flat light

name: [Aesthetic] Metabolism Capsule
nl: Metabolist rendering: stacked prefabricated capsules clipped to concrete cores, repeated round windows, raw grey precast surfaces streaked by weather, flat overcast light, photograph style image.

name: [Aesthetic] CD-ROM Clipart
nl: Mid-1990s clipart rendering: bevelled headings with hard drop shadows, rainbow gradient fills, mismatched stock vector shapes, tiled background pattern and dithered 256-colour banding, graphic style image.

name: [Aesthetic] MS Paint Bitmap
nl: Bitmap-editor rendering: hard aliased brush strokes at one pixel weight, flood-filled areas leaking through gaps, dithered fill patterns, default sixteen-colour palette on white, graphic style image.

name: [Aesthetic] Bento Grid UI
nl: Bento-grid rendering: modular rounded cards packed tight into a strict grid, generous inner padding, one accent hue against near-black, tiny mono labels and soft inner glow, graphic style image.

name: [Aesthetic] Grandmillennial Chintz
nl: Grandmillennial rendering: layered florals, chintz glaze and pleated shades, scalloped trims against wallpaper pattern, warm lamp light on polished mahogany, photograph style image.

name: [Aesthetic] Glitchcore
nl: Glitchcore rendering: hyper-saturated layers stacked and torn, channel-split fringing, stuttered duplicate frames, sticker fragments and noise blocks crowding every gap, graphic style image.

name: [Aesthetic] Angelcore
nl: Angelcore rendering: milky diffused light with feathers adrift in it, marble and pearl surfaces, gold leaf glints, pale cream and blush palette blown gently towards white, photograph style image.
